# cashflow-gpt

> Personal finance through conversation, with calculations in PostgreSQL / Supabase. Russian-language documentation for people and agents. Ships SQL functions, schema, an empty-schema bootstrap, synthetic demo and database tests. A runnable chat adapter and upgrade migrations are not included.

Read only documents relevant to the task. This file is a navigation aid, not a tool configuration or an instruction to execute SQL.

## Entry points

- [Repository agent instructions](AGENTS.md): repository scope, evidence, editing and checks.
- [Task map](docs/index.md): minimal reading paths by intent.
- [Install](docs/start.md): local checks and empty-schema installation.
- [Source layout](docs/source-code.md): canonical SQL files, portability changes and access policy.
- [SQL manifest](database/manifest.json): ordered components, function paths and expected object counts.
- [Runtime agent workflows](docs/agents.md): inputs, clarification, effects, retries and result checks.
- [Project overview](docs/overview.md): purpose and concrete use cases.

## Contracts and reference

- [Application API](docs/api.md): routes, null semantics and parameterized examples.
- [Calculation rules](docs/calculations.md): documented financial semantics.
- [Document manifest](docs/manifest.json): machine-readable routes and documentation status.
- [Function catalog](docs/reference/functions.json): snapshot signatures, overload IDs, anchors and source_path links to SQL bodies.
- [Schema catalog](docs/reference/schema.json): snapshot relations, columns, constraints and trigger links.

## Boundaries

- [Release readiness](docs/release.md): delivered SQL core and remaining release work.
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): 14 passing PGlite checks and 12 native Supabase check groups; reproducible SQL and remaining coverage.
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): error interpretation and recovery.
